question: How do tool-evidence budget and selection affect retained observations, validation errors and total verification cost?
scope: Exploratory follow-up with the actual pinned implementation source supplied identically in every arm; retain the initial series unchanged.

phaseA.priorKnowledge: Review874 and its omitted successful matrix executions are the development incident, not held-out evidence.
phaseA.eligibility: Every completed L2 RESULT validation in the frozen run/prefix with one originating branch in transport evidence. Reconstruct branch/attempt records through the last visible attestation. Include only exact baseline24k rendered-line matches; report all exclusions.
phaseA.privacy: Read snapshots on host. Export only aggregate numeric metrics, source/input hashes and record/event identifiers; no prompts, command text, secrets, traces or artifacts.
phaseA.interpretation: Retention does not establish behavioral coverage, freshness, correctness or automatic acceptance. Historical observations are not upgraded.

phaseB.corpus: Existing proof-replay-2026-10-04 controlled fixtures and independently executed original/corrected/three-mutant oracles; freeze exact requests before calls.
phaseB.payer: existing owner Codex subscription; no model/account changes
phaseB.ordering: Rotate the eight selector/budget arms across case and repeat; serial calls, no tools or store/trust mutation, after the active Attica run ends.
phaseB.negativeControls: Explicit broken behavior, labels without assertions, and unchanged required denial/identity/lifecycle checks are never waived.
phaseB.stopRule: Stop on authorization/quota failure or at 06:55 UTC; save incomplete measurements explicitly rather than changing inputs or thresholds.

costInterpretation.direct: Measure actual tool-free replay usage and latency with the same model/transport.
costInterpretation.retry: Measure historical rework windows without claiming all intervening work was caused by evidence omission; any counterfactual total uses clearly labelled sensitivity estimates.
costInterpretation.limitation: A causal total-run cost conclusion requires paired ordinary end-to-end runs under the same goals/models/sandbox/budgets. No new 90-minute Attica run fits the current session; do not infer an optimal global budget from this pilot.

decision: 40 additional serial tool-free calls, five unchanged cases across eight arms, after the initial 80-call series. Stop on first transport error or 06:55 UTC. Separate descriptive results; no pooled false-refusal causal claim and no automatic production budget change.
followupReason: Initial model refusals on the corrected oracle case ask for otherwise-available seed inventory, a precondition absent from every initial prompt. Such disagreement cannot be attributed solely to truncation. Supply the actual independently executed server source; do not edit tests, expectations, or initial responses.
amendmentReason: Prepared request hashes show 48k and96k are identical under16 padded records, so those arms do not test additional context. Before any follow-up call, raise identical padding to64records and supply actual source in complete1000-character read_file pages, each canonical observation verified not cut. Original 80-call study and the first prepared follow-up inputs remain unchanged on disk.
